DatabaseNameAlreadyExists.title: Database Name Exists
DatabaseNameAlreadyExists.text: A database named "{name}" already exists, please use a different name

DatabaseMustBeArchivedBeforeDelete.title: Archive Required Before Delete
DatabaseMustBeArchivedBeforeDelete.text: The database must be archived before it can be deleted

DataCorruptionCanvasRefMissing.title: Canvas reference missing
DataCorruptionCanvasRefMissing.text: The canvas ({canvas_id}) referenced by canvas node ({node_id}) does not exist

DataCorruptionDanglingShadow.title: Dangling shadow reference
DataCorruptionDanglingShadow.text: The node ({missing_id}) referenced by shadow node ({shadow_id}) does not exist

DataCorruptionEdgeEndpointMissing.title: Edge endpoint missing
DataCorruptionEdgeEndpointMissing.text: The endpoint node ({node_id}) of edge ({edge_id}) does not exist

DataCorruptionMissingShadow.title: Shadow node missing
DataCorruptionMissingShadow.text: The edge ({edge_id}) that should have produced a shadow node is missing its shadow node

DataCorruptionNodeNotShadow.title: Unexpected node type
DataCorruptionNodeNotShadow.text: Expected a shadow node, but this node ({id}) is not a shadow

DataCorruptionShadowChainCycle.title: Shadow chain cycle
DataCorruptionShadowChainCycle.text: A cycle was detected in the shadow node reference chain (node {id})

DataCorruptionShadowEdgeDirectionMismatc.title: Shadow edge direction mismatch
DataCorruptionShadowEdgeDirectionMismatc.text: Shadow node ({shadow_id}) has an edge ({edge_id}) with a mismatched direction

DataCorruptionShadowNeighborIsShadow.title: Shadow-to-shadow connection
DataCorruptionShadowNeighborIsShadow.text: Shadow node ({shadow_id}) is connected to another shadow node ({neighbor_id})

DataCorruptionShadowRootTypeMismatch.title: Shadow root type mismatch
DataCorruptionShadowRootTypeMismatch.text: The root origin node ({root_id}) of shadow node ({shadow_id}) has a type that contradicts the shadow direction

DataVersionMismatch.title: Data Version Mismatch
DataVersionMismatch.text: The database data version is incompatible with this application

EmptyRegistryName.title: Registry Name Empty
EmptyRegistryName.text: Registry variable name cannot be empty

MultipleDataVersion.title: Multiple Data Versions Found
MultipleDataVersion.text: The data version table contains multiple rows

NoDataVersion.title: No Data Version Found
NoDataVersion.text: No data version found in the database

CanvasNameAlreadyExists.title: Canvas Name Exists
CanvasNameAlreadyExists.text: A canvas named "{name}" already exists, please use a different name

CanvasToPlainNodeEdge.title: Canvas node cannot connect to a regular node
CanvasToPlainNodeEdge.text: To make the target node depend on nodes inside a canvas, first create a new sub-canvas and move the target node into it, then connect the canvas node to the new sub-canvas node, so that dependencies stay centralized instead of being scattered across canvases

EdgeWouldFormCycle.title: Edge Would Form Cycle
EdgeWouldFormCycle.text: Creating this edge would form a cycle in the canvas

RootCanvasCannotBeDeleted.title: Root Canvas Cannot Be Deleted
RootCanvasCannotBeDeleted.text: The root canvas is the entry point of canvases and cannot be deleted

ShadowToShadowEdge.title: Shadow nodes cannot connect to each other
ShadowToShadowEdge.text: Shadow nodes symbolize connections and cannot connect to each other; both origins (or their ancestor shadows) reside directly or indirectly in the parent canvas, so connect them directly in the parent canvas instead

UserDatabaseNotOpen.title: User Database Not Open
UserDatabaseNotOpen.text: Please open a user database first

FailToDeserializeNodeFieldValue.title: Failed to read node field data

FieldTypeNotSupportDictionary.title: This field type does not support dictionaries

NodeDeleteDisconnectsNodes.title: Deleting node permanently will disconnect nodes
NodeDeleteDisconnectsNodes.text: The following nodes will lose connection: {nodes}

AttachmentTooLarge.title: Attachment Too Large
AttachmentTooLarge.text: A single attachment must not exceed {max} MB

InvalidExportTargetPath.title: Invalid export target path
InvalidExportTargetPath.text: Invalid export target path: writing into the application's data directory is not allowed ({path})

EdgeDeleteDisconnectsNodes.title: Deleting edge will disconnect nodes
EdgeDeleteDisconnectsNodes.text: The following nodes will lose connection: {nodes}

EdgeSameNodePort.title: Same Node Port
EdgeSameNodePort.text: The source and target nodes use the same port; this connection is not allowed

InvalidShadowEdge.title: Invalid shadow node connection
InvalidShadowEdge.text: An inflow shadow (shadow of a regular node) can only be the source of a connection, and an outflow shadow (shadow of a canvas node) can only be the target

NodeIsCanvasNode.title: Operation not allowed on canvas node
NodeIsCanvasNode.text: A canvas node references a sub-canvas and does not support this operation

NodeIsShadow.title: Operation not allowed on shadow node
NodeIsShadow.text: A shadow node is a reference display of a node from another canvas and does not support this operation

NodeNotInSameCanvas.title: Nodes not in the same canvas
NodeNotInSameCanvas.text: The nodes to relocate must belong to the same canvas

NodeSetHasExternalEdges.title: Node set has external edges
NodeSetHasExternalEdges.text: The node set to relocate has edges connecting to other nodes in the canvas
